name: Markdown Vault
description: Lists markdown notes with frontmatter from a folder of one of your Orca projects on the Tasks page, and starts a workspace for a note.

settings.title: Vault project
settings.description: The Orca project the notes live in: a local folder, a Git or a Perforce project, on this computer or over SSH.

settings.title: Notes folder
settings.description: Folder inside the project, with forward slashes. Empty lists the whole project.

settings.title: Read notes from
settings.description: Latest reads the newest version on the project's server (Git: the fetched upstream branch; Perforce: the depot head), so nothing needs syncing. Disk reads the files in the project folder.

settings.title: Status fields
settings.description: Frontmatter fields holding a note's status, comma-separated; the first one a note sets wins. A long status shows its leading words.

settings.title: Status words
settings.description: One line per tone (open, active, blocked, review, done, closed): the status words that mean it. Done and closed notes cannot start a workspace.
settings.default:
open: open, todo, to do, ready, draft, new
active: active, in progress, doing, started
blocked: blocked, waiting
review: review, in review, waiting review, submitted
done: done, complete, completed, shipped, executed, closed
closed: cancelled, canceled, superseded, parked, dropped

settings.title: Title field
settings.description: Frontmatter field with the title; without it, the first heading, then the file name.

settings.title: Priority field
settings.description: Frontmatter field with the priority; P0 to P3 sort first.

settings.title: Owner field
settings.description: Frontmatter field with the owner (an email or a name).

settings.title: Labels field
settings.description: Frontmatter field with labels, a list or comma-separated.

settings.title: Updated field
settings.description: Frontmatter field with the last-updated date (YYYY-MM-DD); newer notes sort first within a priority.

settings.title: Extra filters
settings.description: Up to four more frontmatter fields to filter by, comma-separated.

settings.title: People file
settings.description: Optional markdown file in the vault project with a table of people (Email and Name columns, optional Aliases), so owners show by name.

settings.title: You
settings.description: How notes name you as owner (an email or a name), for the Mine filter.

settings.title: Work in project
settings.description: The project Start creates the workspace in. Empty uses the vault project.

settings.title: Base field
settings.description: Frontmatter field naming the branch or stream a new workspace starts from.

settings.title: Base prefix
settings.description: Put in front of base values without a slash, e.g. //depot for bare stream names.

settings.title: Model field
settings.description: Frontmatter field with the model to launch the agent with.

settings.title: Effort field
settings.description: Frontmatter field with the reasoning effort to launch the agent with.

settings.title: Agent for model and effort
settings.description: The agent the model and effort fields are written for; other agents launch without them.

settings.title: Start without an agent when
settings.description: field=value: notes that match start a workspace with no agent message, e.g. mode=manual.

settings.title: Agent message
settings.description: The draft first message for the agent. Placeholders: {{title}}, {{path}}, {{slug}}, {{status}}, {{statusText}}, {{owner}}, {{ownerEmail}}, {{priority}}, {{labels}}, {{base}}, and {{field:NAME}} for any frontmatter field.
settings.default:
Work on the note "{{title}}" ({{path}}).

Read that note first: it is your brief.

settings.title: Workspace link notes
settings.description: Lines of key: template kept with the workspace's link to the note (up to eight), with the same placeholders.
